text:
We piloted an AI note-taker with our field sales team for one quarter. Here's what we learned.

**1. Reps got time back.** Post-call admin dropped by roughly 40%. Fewer evenings spent typing up meetings from the car.

**2. CRM data got better.** Notes were more complete and consistent, so managers finally had reliable context for pipeline reviews.

**3. Consent matters.** Some customers hesitated at first. Asking upfront, every time, built trust instead of eroding it.

**4. Summaries aren't strategy.** The tool captured what was said, not what it meant. Reps still had to add judgment.

**5. Adoption took coaching.** Teams that reviewed notes together in weekly huddles stuck with it. Those left alone drifted away.

The takeaway: AI handles the record. People handle the relationship.

What's your team seeing with AI in the field?
